detail.longDescription: CTO role: expand a profitable SaaS into Data & Insights ($600k ARR, 10% equity), Remote & Solo I am looking for a CTO to take our profitable B2B SaaS into its next chapter. You will be the sole engineer in charge of the company, with a 10% equity stake. We are a bootstrapped SaaS with $600k ARR and $250k profit with 1,600 customers. We build tools to help businesses that sell on a large European e-commerce platform, similar to Amazon. Our users rate us with 4.9 out of 5 stars on Google. After 6 years as the founder, I will step back. You will be the sole engineer: no team, no designer, you build it. You get ownership with a 10% equity stake. With ownership comes full responsibility. If something breaks at 9pm, you get an alert and you fix it at 9pm. Even on a holiday. Hence, this job is not for everyone. We have become a successful SaaS through our automations: such as invoicing and emailing. Our software has processed more than 100M orders worth $4B in revenue. Hundreds of sellers use our tools every day. These features stay as they are, and they must keep working. Our next chapter, that you will build out, is on data and insights. A seller can vibecode an automation, but nobody can vibecode a dataset. We have a huge database and many platform API keys. This is our moat. You turn numbers into simple, beautiful tools that make sellers’ lives easier. You talk to customers to find out what they need. Don’t worry - I will help you land and I have a roadmap in mind. We also have competitors to take inspiration from. Just don’t expect a design you only have to implement. You design too. I have been running the place for the past 6 years, and now I want to do something different. I will step out of the day to day. From time to time I will check in with you to decide our roadmap together. Your team consists of an experienced customer support guy. During the week, he brings you some questions that need your technical answer. We have a Systems Administrator that manages our servers. You are the one-man-army, you take pride in high-quality products, and you want the responsibility that comes with them. This is a role for a senior full-stack engineer with 8+ years of experience. You have been responsible for production systems. You have built and released complete features with little or no outside help. If you have not yet owned a live product from end to end, this role comes too early for you. Coding agents make it easier than ever to write code. That lets us build faster and better, but it also invites bloat and slop. Our codebase has been carefully crafted over many years, and you continue to handle it with the care it deserves. Current stack - React, TypeScript - Python, Pyramid - Postgres, SQLAlchemy Details - Salary: €80k - €150k a year (before all taxes) - Equity: 10% after 1 year, with the opportunity to grow further - Fully remote - European or American timezone - Fluent English Interested? Send me an email on jamecroon@protonmail.com (anon mailbox for confidentiality)
